newsitem.title: USA: Omnipoint in pact with Computer City stores.
newsitem.headline: Omnipoint in pact with Computer City stores.

text.p: Omnipoint Corp said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent with Computer City, the nationwide computer outlet division of Tandy Corp.
The company said the Computer City SuperCenters in Omnipoint markets would be premier retail distributors of Omnipoint's Personal Communication Services (PCS) handsets and associated products.
Omnipoint said it launched commercial wireless services in the New York metropolitan area in November, 1996. The company has licenses covering 96.5 million people.
